refined_prompt: Write and merge 5 test cases that validate the finance calculation component 'cade-finance-determine-slice-2' within Tomorrow's risk advisory system. This component determines which financial instruments qualify for risk-based fee tiers by applying a Pareto 80/20 principle: classify high-impact (top 20%) instruments and their constituent risk factors by contribution to portfolio volatility. Behavior to test: (1) Classify instruments into tiers A (high-impact, >20% contribution), B (medium, 5–20%), C (low, <5%); (2) Rank risk factors within each tier; (3) Handle edge case—empty portfolio, single instrument, 100% correlation scenarios; (4) Validate Zod schema compliance with PloehRiskVectorSchema; (5) Verify latency ≤300ms (S2S HMAC window constraint). Add minimal integration: a single handler route server/api/apparently/ploeh/finance-classify.ts that invokes the classifier and returns Zod-validated tier assignments. Output: git commit with test file, handler, and passing test suite. Acceptance: all 5 tests pass, no schema violations, <300ms per request in test benches.
